name: zadok
concept: Zadok Allen, a very old drunk of Innsmouth: ninety, gaunt, a white beard stained yellow, wild white hair, watery red-rimmed eyes, a filthy long black coat over a torn sweater, baggy trousers held by rope, broken boots, a bottle in one coat pocket.
description: Gaunt old man of ninety, wild white hair, long yellowed white beard, red-rimmed watery eyes, filthy long black coat over a torn brown sweater, baggy trousers tied with rope, broken boots.
